name: render-resource-protection-and-idle-presence-guard
changes: Anonymous customer landing-page visits no longer call the backend automatically.
Customer startup now lazy-loads non-home tabs instead of firing all dashboard API requests at once.
When no listener browser is online, idle customer Socket.IO connections are closed automatically and Connect now is disabled.
When the final listener leaves, the server disconnects idle customer realtime sessions while preserving active/reconnecting calls.
Customer direct-message polling is reduced to 30 seconds and pauses while the page is hidden.
Global API and realtime reconnection rate limits reduce scripted resource abuse.
Customer socket connects no longer write last_seen_at on every reconnect.
Customer service-worker cache version bumped so the protection code replaces stale cached JavaScript.
notes: Customers can use Refresh to check availability again after all listeners are offline.
Normal realtime calling remains active while at least one listener is connected, and active calls are never intentionally dropped by the idle guard.
For deliberate volumetric attacks outside the application, keep Cloudflare/WAF rate limiting enabled in front of the deployment.
